title: MountApplicationOptions
summary: Configure hash history and deployment recovery before hydration.

sections.title: Fields
sections.body: hash defaults to false. deployment accepts DeploymentOptions or null. Pass generated deployment metadata during mounting to recover a missing initial route chunk. The previous boolean hash argument remains supported.
sections.code: await mountApplication(routes, root, { hash: false, deployment });

sections.title: Deferred data deadline
sections.body: Initial deferred data has a 30,000 ms deadline after its hydration payload is read. A document connection can stop without firing a browser completion event; unfinished values then reject with Hydration stream timed out and reach their Await errorElement or error boundary. This is a bounded wait, not immediate disconnect detection. Set deferredTimeout to a larger millisecond budget for intentionally slow initial data (1 through 2147483647). There is one timer only when the initial payload contains pending values, cleared on completion or router disposal. No request or mutation is retried, and deployment recovery is not triggered. Ordinary resolved hydration creates no deadline timer.
